Renumber chapter files across ordered folders

Source: R/renumber_chapters_across_folders.R
renumber_chapters_across_folders.Rd

Renumbers chapter files across multiple folders while preserving each file's title slug. This is useful after splitting a book by part, where each part folder starts at 01_... but the full book needs one chronological sequence.

Usage

renumber_chapters_across_folders(
  folders,
  extension = "txt",
  start = 1L,
  width = 2L,
  dry_run = FALSE
)

Arguments

folders

Character vector of folders, in chronological order.

extension

Character scalar file extension to match, without a leading dot by default. Defaults to "txt".

start

Integer scalar. First chapter number to use. Defaults to 1.

width

Integer scalar. Minimum zero-padding width. Defaults to 2.

dry_run

Logical scalar. If TRUE, return the renaming plan without changing files. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A tibble with one row per chapter file and columns describing the old and new file paths.
